parameters.allocation: quota max(f, n*|k|/N); integer parts; remainders by largest fractional part then key; total asserted = n; a stratum smaller than f is taken whole
parameters.draw: one random.Random(seed) consumed by strata in ascending key order; labels sorted; rng.sample
purposive_criteria: CONTRADICTION-ROW: a row whose types contains CONTRADICTION
TWO-FORMAL-ROWS: >= 2 rows with a non-empty type_signature
MATH-STAT-TYPE-QUESTION: a row with review_flag in MATH-QUESTION/STAT-QUESTION/TYPE-QUESTION

strata.pair_count: reconciliation_objects pair_count; bands p0, p1-2, p3+
strata.provenance: PRIMARY-only if every row source's 02-FILES provenance is PRIMARY (vacuously for 0 rows), else ANY-NON-PRIMARY
strata.row_count: distinct rows; bands r0-1 (0-row labels included), r2-3, r4-9, r10+

preregistered_outcome.primary: label yields >= 1 record, passing G-09 and G-12, of kind HYPOTHESIS, STRUCTURE-CANDIDATE, SCHEMA-LIMITATION or GAP-with-NOT-FOUND-AFTER-CENSUS
preregistered_outcome.weighting: every corpus-level rate from the random component weighted by inverse inclusion probability; unweighted rates only as sample descriptives (§9C.1 rule 2)
